subject: Startups
title: Metrics Change as You Scale
description: A short lesson to help you apply Metrics Change as You Scale.

hook.text: The metric that matters at $0 revenue is not the same one that matters at $10M. Metrics evolve with the company.

buildup.text: Pre-launch: focus on engagement and activation. Post-launch: focus on retention and revenue. At scale: efficiency.

discovery.text: A startup obsessing over CAC before it has product-market fit is solving the wrong problem at the wrong time.

twist.text: Facebook ignored revenue until it had hundreds of millions of users. Early monetization would have killed growth.

climax.text: The right metric at the right stage creates focus. The wrong metric at the wrong stage creates waste.

punchline.text: Right metric, wrong stage? That's the trap.

quiz.question: What should pre-product-market-fit startups focus on?
